hook.line: There are only three types of content anybody should be creating if they want to make money.
hook.visual: Close selfie shot in a grey room, hand gesturing at the lens, purple 'The only types of content You should post' title across the top.

beats.what: Selfie talking head with a fixed purple title promising 'the only types of content you should post'
Zoom punch on 'you're missing at least one of these'
Hand pushed toward the lens: 'forget everything you've been told' about content types
Punch in as she reframes the business as a funnel
Orange 'Middle of funnel' bucket graphic slides in below her face, after a blue top-of-funnel one
Full-screen three-layer funnel diagram (blue, orange, green) with Stranger / Aware / Customer labels
'#1 Content that gets you seen' label appears
Screenshot card listing example hooks for top-of-funnel content ('get ready to screenshot')
Second example card for trust-building content
Third example card for lead content, then a follow ask at the end

why_it_works: 'Only three' plus 'you'll know which one you're missing' sets a personal curiosity gap that pays off at each stage
One simple model (a funnel) organises the whole video, so each section slots into a picture the viewer already holds
'Get ready to screenshot' before each example card gives a reason to pause and save
Single-word captions high in the frame stay readable and never cover her face
weaknesses: Almost 30 s of preamble before the first content type; the hook is repeated rather than advanced
Over 2.5 minutes with a static selfie framing and a cut only every ~9 s
Example cards flash for about 1-2 s, too short to read without pausing
for_robert: Pre-announce a saveable card ('screenshot this') and let Fred hold it up or swim in with it; avoid her half-minute preamble before the first point.
